answer: Each identity locks a 1.4ETH stake to an anchor point in the wharf grove; after any vote the grove’s sensor nodes replay its receipt, and fresh signatures reset the local trust sequencer—so a Sybil must rerun the sensor replay for every head, costing one 14ms sensor buffer replay per clone, a cost that compounds since the grove’s sequencer branches diverge with every new transaction and cannot be parallelized across identities.
